item.description:
Mellow 1.0.2 for Apple silicon Macs.
- Redesigned settings and quick panel. - Signed automatic update support with an update-available prompt. - Unified update status in settings and the quick panel.
This prerelease is undergoing update/install qualification. Both the application and disk image have passed Apple notarization. General release promotion awaits the live upgrade and relaunch check.
Earlier builds with updates disabled require one manual installation of an update-enabled release.
